transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because this has been going on almost two years now. I’m sure the contractor, and some people on my block, have been working together quietly to cheat us. They’ve kept my kitchen half-wrong on purpose, and no matter how many receipts my husband shows me or what excuses they give, it doesn’t add up.
Do you think others can hear your thoughts or are talking about you behind your back?

I don’t think they can hear my thoughts, no. But I do think people have been talking about us, yes. The contractor and some people on the block… I’m sure they’ve been quietly working together to cheat us and leave my kitchen wrong on purpose. It’s been going on almost two years, and the receipts and excuses still don’t explain it.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people can't hear?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like that. I don’t hear voices or sounds that other people can’t hear.
Do you think the belief that your contractor and neighbors are working together to cheat you is something that most people would find understandable, or is it a bit unusual?

I suppose some people might think it sounds unusual, but to me it’s understandable because it’s been nearly two years. The kitchen is still not right, and it feels like the contractor and some people around here have been quietly working together to cheat us, no matter what receipts my husband shows me or what excuses they give.
Would you say the idea that your contractor and neighbors are working together to cheat you is a strange or unusual belief to hold?

I guess other people might call it strange, but it doesn’t feel strange to me. I’ve been living with this for almost two years, and I’m sure the contractor and some people on my block have been working together to cheat us and leave my kitchen wrong on purpose. My husband can show me receipts and they can make excuses, but that doesn’t change what I think is going on.
How certain are you that the contractor and your neighbors are working together to cheat you?

I’m very certain. I know other people may not see it the way I do, but after nearly two years of this kitchen still being wrong, I really believe the contractor and some people on my block have been working together to cheat us. My husband can show me receipts, and they can give excuses, but it doesn’t change what I’m sure is happening.
Is your belief that the contractor and neighbors are working together to cheat you something that you think would make sense to anyone, or only to someone who knows all the details you know?

I think it would make sense if someone knew all the details, yes. From the outside maybe people think I’m making too much of it, but I’ve been dealing with this for nearly two years. The kitchen is still half-wrong, and it feels clear to me that the contractor and some people on my block have been working together to cheat us, no matter what receipts my husband shows me or what excuses they give.
Would you describe your belief about the contractor and neighbors as something that is obviously true to you, even if others might not understand it?

Yes. To me it’s obvious. I know other people may not understand it, but I’m sure the contractor and some people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts, and they all have excuses, but that doesn’t change what I can see.
Has your belief that the contractor and neighbors are working together to cheat you ever changed or wavered since you first suspected it?

No, not really. Since I first started suspecting it, it’s only gotten clearer to me. I’ve been sure for nearly two years that the contractor and some people on my block are working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose. My husband shows me receipts, and they all make excuses, but that hasn’t changed what I believe.
How much time do you spend thinking about the contractor and neighbors working together to cheat you on a typical day?

A lot, honestly. It comes up every day. I’ll be in the kitchen and see what’s still wrong, and then I start thinking again about how the contractor and some of the neighbors have been working together to cheat us. I don’t sit and count the hours, but it’s on my mind off and on most of the day.
Has your belief about the contractor and neighbors cheating you affected your relationships with your family or friends?

Yes, it has. I’ve stopped trusting some of the neighbors, and I’m very careful about workers coming around now. It’s caused tension with my husband too, because I keep questioning what people are really doing. He’s had to take over more of the remodeling decisions because I just don’t trust the process anymore.
Has your belief about the contractor and neighbors cheating you made it difficult for you to do everyday tasks or enjoy activities you normally like?

Not really, no. I mean, the remodel part upsets me and I don’t enjoy dealing with that, but outside of that I still do my regular things. I go to church gatherings, book club, keep up with the house, and I still make family plans like I normally would.
Does thinking about the contractor and neighbors cheating you cause you a lot of distress?
I’m not sure I’d say a lot of distress. It bothers me, yes, and I get upset when I think about it, but I don’t know how to measure “a lot.” It’s just something that weighs on me.
Has your belief about the contractor and neighbors cheating you ever interfered with your ability to work or take care of things at home?

No, not really. I’m not working now, but as far as taking care of things at home, I still do my usual routines. Outside of the remodel mess, I still go to church gatherings, book club, keep up with the house, and make plans with my family like I normally do.
Has your belief about the contractor and neighbors cheating you caused you to avoid any specific activities or places?

I wouldn’t say I avoid a lot of places, but I have stopped trusting certain neighbors and workers. I don’t really want to deal with some of them directly now. My husband has had to take over more of the remodeling decisions because I keep questioning what people are really doing.
Would you describe the way the contractor and neighbors are supposedly working together to cheat you as something that could happen in real life?

Yes, I think it could happen in real life. I mean, people do cheat other people, and contractors can cut corners. I’ve been sure for nearly two years that he and some people on my block are quietly working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen half-wrong on purpose. Even when my husband shows me receipts or they give explanations, it still doesn’t feel right to me.
Is the idea that your contractor and neighbors are working together to cheat you something that you think could happen to anyone, or is it a very unusual or unlikely scenario?

I think it could happen to anyone, honestly. People get cheated by contractors, and neighbors can get involved in things quietly. I know it may sound unlikely to some people, but to me it’s what’s been happening with my kitchen for almost two years now. Even when my husband shows me receipts or they give reasons, I still don’t believe they’re being straight with us.
How unusual do you think it is for a contractor and neighbors to work together to cheat someone in the way you've described?

I don’t think it’s that unusual, really. Maybe the way it’s happened to us sounds strange to other people, but contractors cheat people, and neighbors can get involved or look the other way. I’ve been sure for nearly two years that this contractor and some people on my block are working together, keeping the kitchen wrong on purpose. My husband shows me receipts and they give excuses, but it still doesn’t add up to me.
Do you think there's any possibility, no matter how small, that the contractor and neighbors are not working together to cheat you?

Honestly, no, not really. I know you’re asking if there’s even a small chance, but I’ve been sure for almost two years that the contractor and some of the neighbors are in on this together. My husband can show me receipts, and they can give their explanations, but it still feels like excuses to me. The kitchen being left half-wrong like this just doesn’t seem accidental.
